BASE.prompt: A cute round red Pixar-style mascot with antennae stands still in front of a glowing purple magic portal. Its big mouth is frozen wide open in a huge happy grin, showing white teeth and a pink tongue. It slowly raises one hand. Its antennae wobble softly. Slow, calm, smooth 3D animation, cinematic lighting, static camera.
BASE.negative: talking, speaking, moving mouth, lip movement, chattering, worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted, deformed, extra limbs, watermark, text

STYLES.name: Balanced (start here)
STYLES.help: The settings that gave our best clips. Try this first.

STYLES.name: Soft and calm
STYLES.help: Small, slow, gentle movement. Good for faces and close-ups.

STYLES.name: Very soft (barely moves)
STYLES.help: Almost a living photo: breathing, blinking, light sway.

STYLES.name: Lively
STYLES.help: More movement and energy than Balanced.

STYLES.name: Strong (big moves)
STYLES.help: Big movements. Can change the character more - try a few seeds.

STYLES.name: Stay close to the picture
STYLES.help: Keeps the look of your picture as exact as possible. Moves less.

STYLES.name: Free and creative
STYLES.help: Lets the model change things more. Surprising results, good and bad.

STYLES.name: Sharper details
STYLES.help: Spends more effort on fine detail (eyes, edges), a bit less on motion.

STYLES.name: Slow motion
STYLES.help: Same movement, played slower. The video gets longer (about 4 s).

STYLES.name: Short clip (2 s)
STYLES.help: Shorter and faster to make. The end melts less.

STYLES.name: Clip 3 s
STYLES.help: A bit longer than the default 2 s. Still holds together well.

STYLES.name: Clip 4 s
STYLES.help: Longer video. Keep the action simple so the end does not drift.

STYLES.name: Long clip (5 s)
STYLES.help: Longer video. The end can melt or drift - use a simple action.

QUALITY.name: Draft - fastest
QUALITY.help: 512x288. About 2-3 min on a low-end GTX 1050 Ti 4 GB; a better card is faster. For trying ideas and seeds.

QUALITY.name: Normal (recommended)
QUALITY.help: 768x416. About 6 min on a low-end GTX 1050 Ti 4 GB; a better card is faster. What all our good clips used.

QUALITY.name: High
QUALITY.help: 960x544. Sharper, slower (about 10-12 min on a low-end GTX 1050 Ti 4 GB; a better card is faster). May run out of memory on a 4 GB card.

QUALITY.name: Best - Full HD
QUALITY.help: Normal, then a second pass to 1080p. Much sharper, very slow (about 30-50 min on a low-end GTX 1050 Ti 4 GB; a better card is faster).

QUALITY.name: Manual size
QUALITY.help: Type your own width and height (multiples of 32). Bigger = slower.

CAM.panr: Slow camera pan to the right.
CAM.panl: Slow camera pan to the left.

AVOID: extra arms, extra hands, blurry, deformed, talking, text, watermark
